Move slowly to avoid over-aggroing. ** There are a few hidden [[devourer]]s and possibly [[Sand Wurm]]s in the southeastern and eastern sections. ** The western section can be difficult due the [[knock down]]s from [[Sand Elemental]]s and [[Sand Drake]]s; pull carefully, bring anti-KD skills, or, at least, keep your party spread out. ** A lone [[Hydra]] group patrols the northwest and is easily missed because it starts circling clockwise when you enter its radar range. To avoid hunting for it, approach from the east when you first encounter it (so that it moves towards you); if you think you missed it, start your own patrol in a counter-clockwise direction. The group does not always spawn. ** There are also two lone sand drakes, one patrolling East-West in the NW and one patrolling North-South in the far West, which may not appear until after you have left that region of the map. ** Two groups of Sand Giants patrol the Eastern side of the zone. ** It might take some time to finding the last foes on this map as it is very vast to navigate. ** Bring [["Can't Touch This!"]] or [["Don't Trip!"]]: [[touch skill]]s and AoE [[knockdown]] are abundant! {{Explorable areas in the Crystal Desert}} [[de:Geierdünen]]
